explanation: In Russia, patting someone on the head is considered patronizing and disrespectful, as the head is viewed as a sacred part of the body. This gesture is typically reserved for small children or pets, and doing it to an adult can be seen as an insult to their dignity.
local_tip: Instead of touching the head, offer a firm handshake or a nod to show respect in social gatherings.

also_check.note: The head is considered the most sacred part of the body in Thai culture, and touching it is a major taboo.
While patting a child's head may be acceptable, touching an adult's head is generally avoided due to spiritual beliefs about the head being sacred.
Patting someone on the head can be seen as condescending or overly familiar, though it may be acceptable among close friends or in playful contexts.
